museum_template|environmentalreadingscor.description: Difference between maximum and minimum temperature recorded by a monitor in the preceding 24 hours.
museum_template|environmentalreadingscor.definition: tempvar24h = MAX(tempc) OVER (PARTITION BY TRIM(monitorcode) ORDER BY CAST(readtimestamp AS TIMESTAMP) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '24 hours' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) - MIN(tempc) OVER (PARTITION BY TRIM(monitorcode) ORDER BY CAST(readtimestamp AS TIMESTAMP) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '24 hours' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)

museum_template|environmentalreadingscor.description: Difference between maximum and minimum relative humidity recorded by a monitor in the preceding 24 hours.
museum_template|environmentalreadingscor.definition: humvar24h = MAX(relhumidity) OVER (PARTITION BY TRIM(monitorcode) ORDER BY CAST(readtimestamp AS TIMESTAMP) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '24 hours' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) - MIN(relhumidity) OVER (PARTITION BY TRIM(monitorcode) ORDER BY CAST(readtimestamp AS TIMESTAMP) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '24 hours' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
